result.title: Quantifying Trait-State Hierarchy in EEG Foundation Model and Signal Processing Embeddings
result.summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) measures brain activity through recording electrical potentials of the scalp. EEG recordings capture two distinct sets of characteristics in the signal: (1) \emph{Traits} -- information that remains relatively constant over the course of a recording session, such as subject identity, age, and sex; (2) \emph{States} -- signatures that encode responses to external stimuli, including visual, auditory, and motor information. There is limited understanding of how different EEG modeling features (signal processing and foundation models) encode state and trait characteristics. In this work, we quantify state- and trait-level features captured by EEG embeddings using a hierarchy metric and kNN purity on Brain-Computer Interface dataset trials, and find that a majority of EEG features form a macro-trait hierarchy (embeddings form trait-level clusters with micro-states within). Our linear probe results indicate that this hierarchy structure leads to suboptimal state distinguishability, negatively impacting BCI performance of EEG foundation models. To mitigate this, we explore normalization techniques that reduce trait-specific information in embeddings and provide a $\sim$ 10\% improvement in balanced accuracy for state classification. Additionally, we observe that when fine-tuning models for downstream state decoding, embedding spaces transform from macro-trait to macro-state hierarchies, which in turn lead to better state decoding.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作在 EEG 数据集上用层级度量与 kNN 纯度量化信号处理与基础模型嵌入中的「特质—状态」层级，发现多数嵌入呈宏观特质层级、损害状态可分性，并以归一化削弱特质信息使状态分类平衡准确率提升约 10%，且微调会使嵌入空间转为宏观状态层级。
AI.relevance_reason: 其层级度量和去特质归一化提供了诊断潜表示中任务相关状态与个体/干扰信息混杂的具体手段，可供核查 LVR 中 latent 内容筛选、表示坍缩与线性可读性问题；但属 EEG/BCI 领域，跨到视觉多模态推理的适用性需验证。
